component: IMAP folder-copy dispatch and xpcshell regression coverage

quotes.text: the source folder should remain in place with its message

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Same-server moves use the native MoveFolder branch; same-account copies retain false isMoveFolder and use the folder-copy state. The added test synchronizes a one-message IMAP source before copying it, then directly checks one message in the destination copy and one in the original source. The folder menu/drop wiring supports this production operation. These are static source and direct assertion scopes; message-byte identity, server interoperability and fresh test execution are not established.
title: The same-account IMAP folder-copy regression checks both the copy and the surviving source
